name: The Stone Sovereign: The Cazhaak Creed

description.value:
The Stone Sovereign is the foundational faith of Cazhaak Draal, revered by the medusas, gargoyles, and stone-shapers of Droaam. Communing with living granite and basalt under the patronage of Queen Sheshka and ancient earth spirits, the creed views stone as sacred, permanent, and divine. Petrification is seen not as a curse, but as the ultimate preservation of mortal deeds in living rock.
Areas of Concern Earth, monumental masonry, petrification, sculpture, endurance, duty
Alignment LN
Divine Font Harm or Heal
Divine Ability Constitution or Wisdom
Divine Skill Crafting
Domains Duty, Earth, Perfection, Protection
Cleric Spells 1st: pummeled rubble, 4th: shape stone, 5th: form of stone
Edicts Create enduring monuments, preserve history in stone, study masonry and sculpture, protect petrified forms from desecration, act deliberately and with patience.
Anathema Desecrate sacred stone sculptures or petrified creatures, act recklessly or rashly, allow ancient monuments to crumble without effort to preserve them.
Favoured Weapon Pick, Heavy Pick
